observations: Three laminated paper assemblies surround a central open space. Two upright green leaves fold outward; the terracotta lower assembly bends at both shoulders. Thin pale cores are visible at the edges. There is no backing plate or enclosing border. The pale green right leaf renders nearly white; material credibility, small-size readability and brand specificity still need independent review.
user_feedback: Open paper structures are allowed, without an enclosing border or backing plate. No artistic approval supplied.
